title: Prepare crystal structures
action: Obtain initial crystal structures for o-IrPTe (paracostibite type, Pbca), c-IrPTe (ullmannite type, P2₁3), elemental Ir (fcc), black P (orthorhombic), Te (trigonal), and binaries IrP₂ (marcasite type) and IrTe₂ (CdI₂ type) from public crystallographic databases. Prepare DFT input files for structural relaxation.
description: Process step to obtain the input geometries required for all subsequent DFT calculations.

title: DFT structural relaxations
action: Using an open-source plane‑wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) with GGA/PBE functional and SSSP pseudopotentials, perform full geometry optimization for all structures (o‑IrPTe, c‑IrPTe, Ir, P, Te, IrP₂, IrTe₂) on a dense k‑mesh. Extract relaxed geometries and total energies.
description: Process step that generates the relaxed structures and total energies needed for formation energy and band‑gap calculations.

title: Formation energy, band gap, and polymorph energy difference
action: From the relaxed total energies of o‑IrPTe and the elements, calculate the formation energy of o‑IrPTe in kJ/mol. Perform a band‑structure calculation on the optimized o‑IrPTe geometry; determine the direct band gap (eV) and its type. Also, from the relaxed total energies of o‑IrPTe and c‑IrPTe, compute the energy difference ΔE = E(o‑IrPTe) - E(c‑IrPTe) in kJ/mol. Optionally compute the transition pressure from equation of state fits. Write all results to main_results.json.
description: Scored step producing the main reproduction targets: formation energy, direct band gap, and the o‑ vs c‑IrPTe energy difference.
output_schema: JSON object with required keys: formation_energy_kJ_per_mol (float), band_gap_direct_eV (float), band_gap_type (string, 'direct' or 'indirect'), delta_E_kJ_per_mol (float). Optional keys: o_lattice_parameters (list of three floats), transition_pressure_kbar (float).
